(nga )༄༅/ /slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga mkhas pa'i zhal lung bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga mkhas pa'i zhal lung bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/ stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi gsang ba'i bdag /bskal pa'i me dang phrad pa'i dbang sngon ri// mtshungs las lhag pa'i gzi brjid lham me ba// de yi sgrub thabs rjes gnang rnam gsal bri// de'ang phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs sam gos sngon can gyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas/ mngon par rtogs pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du btang nas/ rang skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje stobs po che// zhes sogs shlau ka res phyag bya/ oṃ nī lamba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhūppe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi tye/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ tshogs rten rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pas gser

'gro bzang snying po'i gzhung du khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po 'byung*/ sngags 'chang shākya dpal sogs brgyud pa'i gsung sgros rnams las rdo rje ser por bzhed pa mang ngo*// gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar bas steng phyogs gza'i gdon thams cad skrag par mdzad pa/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas 'og phyogs klu'i gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sku stod la dar sngon po'i na bza' dang sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskul zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga'i lha tshogs oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag

chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sprul sku rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can gyis dbur brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ nī lamba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phyag na rdo rje stobs po che// gtum po drag po rdo rje'i sku// mi bzad nam mkha'i mdog 'dra ba// 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod cing nga rgyal bzung*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib gdon bgegs thams cad sbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par bsams la/ oṃ nī lamba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags de brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas mthar/ mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas skabs su steng gdon dang 'og gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa lta bu'i 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag bcu'am bcu bzhi'i bar du bsog go /gtor ma 'bul na/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor mgron sngar bzhin bskyed pa'am bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drangs pa la/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar phul la/ mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ gtor mgron brtan bzhugs bya ba'am gshegs su gsol ba skabs su gang bab byas la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur zhes sogs kyis dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o// bstod pa rgyas par ni/ hūm̐ bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can// klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan// zhe sdang can rnams 'dul ba'i rtags// nyon mongs spangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag na rdo rje stobs po che// rdo rje lan gsum gsor ba yis// gnod sbyin drag po 'dul mdzad pa// gnod sbyin gos sngon phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na// rgyal po brtul nas nor sgrub mdzad// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// rnam rgyal khro bo'i skur bstan nas// khro bo'i ngar skad drag po yis// thams cad kun 'dul phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// mkha' lding rgyal po'i skur sprul nas// klu rgyal thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa'i// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag tu// nag po chen po'i skur sprul nas// ru tra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes pas bstod do// rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ stegs kyi khar maṇḍal tshom bu'i mthar/ chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas skor dang*/ mdun du zlum gtor gcig rnams bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams nyer bsdogs byas/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par bsams la oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya dharma ra ṇi bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/

skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed gong ltar nyams su blangs/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ tshom bu la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs sngar bzhin du phyag na rdo rje yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod dharma ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa gong ltar bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa can la oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhiḥlo tsā ni sarba artha sā dha ni swā hā zhes sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags dang*/ na maḥsarb+ba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas rgyas par spel/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ nī lamba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi ādzñā pa ya ti i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhimme pra yatstshantu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha ya swā hā zhes gsum mam lnga la sogs pas dbul/ gtor ma byin rlabs dang 'bul ba'i sngags de ltar mi nus pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ nī lamba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi a kā ro mu khaṃ lan gsum gyis 'bul yang btub/ mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel// sku gsum lhun gyis grub par mdzod// ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/

mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya ba rnams ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas nas gral la 'khod pa la sems bskyed gsal gdab tu gzhug 'dir skabs su bab pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po 'gro bzang snying po'i zhabs kyis legs par bkral ba'i phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub par byas/ slob ma'i bya ba la slob dpon dang phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can tha mi dad pa la rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab nas/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par bsams la/ de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs kyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba dang byin gyis brlabs pa ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi'i don du slob dpon phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang gdos bcas kyi lus sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma dang a las zla ba'i sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar phyag na rdo rje mngon rtogs bzhin du bskyed/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ sngags dang dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod cing dril bu gsil/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag phyag na rdo rje'i sku bsgom pa la dbang ba yin no// gsung bzlas pa'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rnams phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ nī lamba ra sogs kyi rjes zlos byas la/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa dang*/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod cing spyi bor me tog gtor/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag phyag na rdo rje'i gsung gsang sngags bzlas brjod byed pa la dbang ba yin no// 'di la lha bsgom pa dang sngags kyi bzlas lung gnyis kho na las gzhan mi dgos par gsungs so// des gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs spyi ltar bya'o// yang na bdag mdun sgrub cing mchod pa rnams sngar ltar byas nas rjes gnang gi chings sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar sbyar ba'i lugs kyang bshad pa yod do// rjes kyi mchod pa kha bsos te byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags re res sngon du 'gro bas mchod cing bstod nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do// bde gshegs yongs kyi mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal// gcig bsdus dbang sngon lhun po bskal pa'i mes// lan brgyar 'khyud pas mtshon min dpa' bo che// phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// go bder bgyis pa'i legs byas rtse brgya pas// bdud dpung ri bo'i rgyun lugs yongs bcad de// gsang chen bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar bab glu// snyan dgu bskal pa'i bar du sgrogs gyur cig /ces phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga mkhas pa'i zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer gyi ngor bande tshul rin gyis sbyar ba'o// brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ bram ze sadzdza na/ jo bo te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ 'jad phu ba padma bkra shis/ lha rje stag pa jo bzang*/

bla ma byams pa lo tsā ba/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu rin chen bsod nams seng ge bla ma yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ de las chos rje sgeg lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor dang*/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka las 'jam dbyangs byams gling pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ thugs sras 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ ngag dbang tshul khrims bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang bsod nams dbang phyug mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ des bande tshul khrims rin chen la stsal to// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
